# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b14 — Rooms first, explicit inputs, one final save

This opt-in beta replaces the public initial/options configuration route with the requested ordered setup. Existing Home, room-hub, managed-device and entity identities are preserved. Stable v0.5.1 and earlier beta tags are unchanged.

## Configuration order

1. Select the Home Assistant rooms/areas to monitor. All real areas are available, including rooms without windows or climate equipment.
2. For each selected room, complete one page with six separate multi-select fields, in this order: **windows; air-quality and other supported environmental sensors; temperature sensors; humidity sensors; pressure sensors; climate/fan/humidity devices**. Each option shows **device name — entity name**, with the exact entity ID for disambiguation. Choices belong to that room and the correct supported category; generated Manager entities are never offered as physical sources.
3. Complete **General settings** for shared weather/outdoor/warning inputs, occupancy and sleeping-room sources, pollen, announcement targets, TTS/AI choices, language and mold indication.
4. Submit the final page. Configuration is complete. There is no additional climate, PID or device-selection menu to finish.

The same ordered route is used when reopening Configure. Nothing is persisted until the final valid submit. Cancelling or submitting invalid inputs does not mutate saved nested settings. Concurrent unrelated device-setting changes are preserved; a conflicting edit aborts rather than overwriting the other change.

## The selected lists actually control monitoring

These are positive per-room source selections, not cosmetic filters. An explicitly empty list remains empty instead of falling back to every automatically discovered sensor. Rooms without windows remain monitorable, while automatic hardware interlocks continue to treat missing window evidence conservatively. A selected missing/unavailable window does not silently disappear as though closed.

Room temperature is derived only from the selected valid sensors, normalized to Celsius before averaging when several are selected. If a selected input is missing, stale or invalid, the aggregate is unavailable rather than silently changing its source set. Humidity and qualified device feedback follow the same explicit-source boundaries. Pressure selections are retained in room input diagnostics and normalized to hPa; this does not claim a new pressure-based physical control algorithm.

Changing or removing a pinned control-feedback source withdraws the affected automatic-control grant instead of silently substituting another measurement into a live loop. Mold calibration is invalidated when its calibration source changes. Deselecting a room disables its monitoring and prior controller grants without deleting saved tuning.

## Home hub and room hubs after setup

The Home hub retains general input/output entities and shared adjustable policies. Every selected room has its native room group, a general room-settings/overview device and one managed controller device per selected physical product. Multiple selected native endpoints of one product remain on that single logical device, with independent channels preserved. Original native physical devices remain attached to their own integrations and gateways.

The room overview includes the selected source entity IDs and raw input status. Climate targets, presets, Automatic/Manual/Off/PID, gains and quiet settings remain on the managed devices. Selecting equipment does not start it or silently grant automatic power control. Existing equipment commissioning, ownership and minimum-runtime protections are retained.

## Languages, testing and installation

All 38 supplied language catalogs include the ordered setup and its field explanations, including Greek. Publication is gated by Python 3.13/3.14 regression tests, reproducible translations, frontend and compilation checks, HACS, Hassfest, and isolated tests using installed Home Assistant 2026.10 selectors and registries. Those tests do not operate or certify physical equipment and do not represent live testing on the user's installation.

In HACS enable **Show beta versions**, select **v0.6.0b14**, restart Home Assistant and refresh the integration page. Keep your existing entry. Open Configure to review the imported room/source selections and finish General settings. Existing installations that have not yet saved the new source lists retain their previous discovery behavior until the explicit setup is completed.

The manual installation ZIP and SHA-256 checksum are attached. This is a prerelease and is not marked stable Latest.
